threads.body: [Testing] The regression test only exercises sensitive query parameters, not the Camel-specific userinfo credential leak that is the primary security issue here. Please add coverage using an endpoint/header URL such as `http://user:secret@host/...` and assert that Camel records `REDACTED:REDACTED@host`; the existing extractor tests do not exercise Camel's endpoint-URI fallback or header handling.

[Style] This class is in an `.internal` package, where the Java style rules explicitly avoid adding `final` to classes. The private constructor already prevents subclassing, so remove `final`.

This issue also appears on line 19 of the same file.
